analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free caused by xmlXIncludeIncludeNode freeing the original xi:include node (xmlFreeNode(cur) in the XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE path) after moving included/fallback children with xmlAddPrevSibling, without repairing namespace ownership/references. Namespace objects allocated for the include node (e.g., xmlns:xi) are freed via xmlFreeNode/xmlFreeNsList, but moved nodes still reference them (directly or via nsDef/ns pointers). Later serialization in xmlNodeDumpOutputInternal dereferences cur->ns->prefix (xmlsave.c:911), reading freed memory.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In fuzz/xml.c, input is parsed with xmlReadMemory using fuzzer-controlled opts; when XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE is set, xmlXIncludeProcessFlags triggers xmlXIncludeIncludeNode. A document containing xi:include with fallback content and namespace declarations can cause moved nodes to retain pointers to namespaces owned by the soon-freed include node. After XInclude processing, xmlDocDumpMemory serializes the mutated tree and hits UAF when accessing namespace fields.
